competency.title: Define speech perception — distribution shift
competency.outcome: Specify operational terms and boundaries for speech perception using a speech-to-intent transcript. Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.

topic_kernel.measure: word error and intent accuracy by noise level

competency.practice_task: Produce a glossary with a positive and a negative case grounded in a speech-to-intent transcript.
competency.setting_constraint: Fit on one distribution and evaluate on a separately documented shift.
required_evidence: a glossary with a positive and a negative case
Include shift definition and in/out-distribution results.
Report word error and intent accuracy by noise level with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: inventing speech in silence.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of speech perception.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report word error and intent accuracy by noise level against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for inventing speech in silence; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
